title: Returns Policy
text: Returns Policy: Returns are allowed within 7 days of delivery for unused products with original packaging. Discounted products are returnable only if the discount is 30 percent or less.

title: Exchange Policy
text: Exchange Policy: Size exchanges are allowed within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. Exchange is not available for intimate wear or final sale products.

title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
text: Shipping & Delivery Policy: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery usually takes 1 to 2 business days in serviceable locations.

title: Refund Policy
text: Refund Policy: Refunds are processed after the returned item passes quality inspection. Prepaid refunds are generally issued within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Warranty Policy
text: Warranty Policy: Watches and selected accessories carry a 6-month manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects only. Physical damage is not covered.
